infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TrailGuard uses your location to track hike routes and broadcast GPS coordinates during emergencies.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: TrailGuard connects with your wearable device via Bluetooth Low Energy to stream vitals and fall detection telemetry.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: TrailGuard pairs with smart wearable sensors via BLE.
